features.name: Minimal repository harness and visual workflow acceptance
features.description: Add persistent task state, read-only Windows verification, and session lifecycle rules. Require visual form-based acceptance of affected state transitions and reversal cycles for future behavior changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Startup routes to state and read-only verification; completion and session closure require recorded evidence.
The verifier checks state, dependencies, completion evidence, visual scenario gates, and relative documentation links without building, launching, or accessing a database.
Behavior acceptance prioritizes real desktop form flows, allowed and blocked transitions, reversals, repeated cycles, and persisted readback; missing visual evidence blocks completion.
Checks and limitations are recorded; application files and preexisting local files are preserved.

features.evidence: 2026-10-03: init.ps1 passed state/completion checks, 159 relative file links, and git diff --check. Fourteen isolated negative checks rejected invalid state/dependencies/scope and unsupported completion claims without changing repository harness hashes. Structural audit improved from 36 to 84/100. Source/content/diff review confirmed the six-file authorized scope and visual acceptance policy. See progress.md for commands, boundaries, and next action. No application build, launch, or database exercise was performed.

features.name: Local desktop-testing environment and visual state-machine validation
features.description: Install an optional machine-local toolset (Windows-MCP 0.8.7 + pywinauto 0.6.9 under %LOCALAPPDATA%, external OpenCode config and launcher), build the application, and validate the state machine through real form interaction against the authorized non-production database. Keep installs and detailed evidence outside the repository; document how to replicate them.

acceptance_criteria.description: External environments, pinned versions, launcher, and read-only environment check exist outside the repository; the app builds and runs without them.
Both drivers were validated on a throwaway window with real input, including their documented limitations.
Budget, repair, test, reopen, delivery, delivery-cancellation and warranty re-entry cycles were exercised through the forms with observed states and results.
Replicable documentation was added and linked from the guides; test records were kept for owner review as requested.

visual_scenarios.description: Emit budget -> cancel the annulment dialog (regret) -> annul with reason -> re-emit -> approve.
visual_scenarios.evidence: progress.md verification table and external evidence visual-validation-20261003.md; observed Esperando respuesta -> (unchanged) -> Pendiente presupuesto -> Esperando respuesta -> Autorizado reparacion on order 1004.

visual_scenarios.description: Start/finish repair, register approved and failed tests, annul the failed test, finalize, reopen tests, finalize again.
visual_scenarios.evidence: External evidence visual-validation-20261003.md; observed En pruebas -> Listo retiro/Reparado -> En pruebas (result cleared) -> Listo retiro/Reparado.

visual_scenarios.description: Deliver -> cancel delivery with reason -> finalize -> deliver again; also on a NoReparable order.
visual_scenarios.evidence: External evidence visual-validation-20261003.md; orders 1002 (No reparable result retained) and 1005 (repaired delivery returned to En pruebas, result cleared).

visual_scenarios.description: Automatic 30-day warranty on delivery, then warranty re-entry from the delivered order, reparable diagnosis and acceptance.
visual_scenarios.evidence: External evidence visual-validation-20261003.md; warranty row Vigente for order 1005; re-entry order 1006 Recibido -> Pendiente evaluacion garantia -> Autorizado reparacion with the original untouched.

features.evidence: 2026-10-03: MSBuild Debug/Any CPU build succeeded for all six projects. Windows-MCP and pywinauto validated on a throwaway WinForms window with real input. Five AGENT_ test orders (1002-1006) exercised the budget, repair, test-annulment, reopen, delivery, delivery-cancellation and warranty re-entry transitions through the forms; records intentionally kept for review. External tooling at %LOCALAPPDATA%\ServicioTecnicoDesktopTests; detailed evidence in its evidence\visual-validation-20261003.md. Repository changes: this tracker, progress.md, docs/agents/desktop-testing.md, and guide links only.

features.name: Scoped test policy and full business test catalogue
features.description: Adopt scoped acceptance for feature tasks (only the affected transitions and direct effects) and restrict full or partial business-flow sweeps to explicit user requests. Add the maintained business test catalogue covering every business module with reversal, regret, blocked and repeated cycles, cross-module interactions, known-defect findings and execution phases A-F. Record the handoff for executing sweeps in a new session.

acceptance_criteria.description: Policy scopes per-task acceptance and limits full sweeps to explicit user requests.
The catalogue covers every business module with reversal/regret/blocked/repeat scenarios, cross-module effects, known defects and phases A-F.
Guides and index link the catalogue; the harness verifier passes.
A handoff for executing sweeps in a new chat is recorded.
Coverage audit against the real module inventory closed gaps: golden path, list quick paths, cross-cutting checks and missing module scenarios.

features.evidence: 2026-10-03: docs-only task. Added docs/agents/business-test-catalogue.md (18 sections: CLI, EQP, CAT, ORD, DIA, PRE, ADI, REP, PRU, ENT, STK, PRO, COM, GAR, DSH, INF, PERM-01, INT plus cross-cutting HIST/LIST/LANG; known defects marked as findings; phases A-F; golden path). Coverage audit compared APPLICATION/Features (16 folders; 6 administration excluded) and PRESENTATION/Forms against the catalogue: all business modules covered; gaps closed (golden path, ORD-08/ENT-08 cancellation and quick-delivery from the orders list, COM-10 purchase list actions, PRE-13 draft persistence, GAR-11 view original, STK-01 initial-stock fields, HIST-01/LIST-01/LANG-01 cross-cutting checks). Scoped-acceptance policy added to AGENTS.md and development-and-testing.md; catalogue linked from the index. Handoff recorded in progress.md. No application build, launch, or database write was performed; sweeps will run in a new session with the external environment.
